original_text.raw_value: load a screw-cap reaction tube with a stir bar and 4 Å molecular sieves (50 mg); evacuate, flame-dry and back-fill with argon; add (R)-TRIP-PA PA1 (5 mol%), freshly distilled aldehyde (0.1 mmol) and dry cyclohexane (1.0 mL); add B10 (0.12 mmol) by syringe dropwise over 30 s; stir 8 h at room temperature; load directly onto silica and flash chromatograph with ethyl acetate/hexane 1:9
original_text.normalized_value: load a screw-cap reaction tube with a stir bar and 4 Å molecular sieves (50 mg); evacuate, flame-dry and back-fill with argon; add (R)-TRIP-PA PA1 (5 mol%), freshly distilled aldehyde (0.1 mmol) and dry cyclohexane (1.0 mL); add B10 (0.12 mmol) by syringe dropwise over 30 s; stir 8 h at room temperature; load directly onto silica and flash chromatograph with ethyl acetate/hexane 1:9
